epistemic_firewall: A modern Egyptian-looking meme image is not evidence for an ancient meme practice.
The South Park frame does not prove that ancient Egyptians performed Donkey Ticking, Faith Hilling, Harlem Shake, or any modern meme gesture.
Hunefer/Ani-style iconographic similarity does not establish an exact papyrus source until the source image is matched directly.
The 2013 Harlem Shake association, if present in later circulation, is secondary audience re-encoding and cannot be projected backward into the 2012 South Park production context.
Faxlore is used as a comparative transmission model, not as provenance for the image.
This branch belongs to JANUS IO / Machine Cultural Transmission and must not be used as archaeological evidence in Osiris/Mendes/Oxyrhynchus relic gates.
